interpretation: Bounded routing for an adult using their own personal Google account when a phone or second factor is unavailable. Previously configured verification options are suggestions within Google sign-in, never a guarantee. Managed accounts, uncertain scope and Advanced Protection are handed to official instructions. A missing or unknown password uses the official recovery route.
uncertainties: Google decides which verification options it offers and whether ownership is established.
The adult-only scope and conservative unknown/out-of-scope handoffs are project scope decisions, not universal Google eligibility findings.
